environment: Windows; Node 24.22.1; Playwright 1.63.0 / Chromium 153.0.8010.12; Firefox 155 / WebKit 26.6 limited core flows; ja-JP; Asia/Tokyo; 1440/1024/375/320 CSS px; Poppler 120 dpi; bundled Python/Pillow/pypdf. Current visual evidence uses the existing verification harness; CUA Chrome capture/upload limitations recorded separately.
reviewer: NOEMA; AI UI/PDF visual review on 2026-10-22; not a human usability study

default-page-quality.notes: Current-source target/common-style views inspected. Quiet Book/Edit navigation, explicit target, visible alignment, same source projection, white paper and stable workspace. Ten unique changed references inspected individually; hard checks and zero-pixel limits retained.

vertical-glyphs-and-spacing.notes: All raster contact sheets and native ruby/emphasis/Latin/TCY and TOC views inspected. No observed unintended clipping/overlap in these fixtures. Full glyph metrics, missing-glyph detection, advanced ruby and JLREQ remain unfinished.

mobile-usability.notes: Current 320px object and common-style forms inspected. Selected type/scope, direct properties, deliberate layer multi-selection, focus and preserved source checked in the harness. Real phones, software keyboards, actual Safari/IME/assistive technology and human usability are untested.

export-appearance.notes: All 35 raster physical pages from seven primary and two actual excerpt PDFs independently rendered and inspected, plus all five static-PDF preservation comparisons. Four rotations, nonzero crop, UserUnit, transparency, original text and CMYK operators independently checked. No body text-PDF, arbitrary-PDF, PDF/X or print-shop approval claim.

local-first.notes: Canonical book/source kept local. Delayed-save regression, conflict/quota/reload, source loss protection, portable ZIP hashes/font continuity and minimal Worker transfer checked. Publication uses code/dependencies only; runtime manuscripts, imported assets and output are excluded.
